'''Charles Reskin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he led a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to infiltrate a base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, he was having trouble with his troops when the [[Exchange]] was dealing [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to the Imperials. He sent an ally to drive out the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] their boss, [[Sindal Reed]].<ref name="TOR" />
